battle.name: 巴巴羅薩
battle.brief: 初期的包圍戰打死的是尚未展開的部隊。冬天與搬不走的工廠還沒出場。

kit.name: BT-7
kit.history: 快、薄、砲小。它的懸吊與車體思路會流向 T-34，但 1939–41 的它擋不住後續的穿甲彈。

countries: 巴巴羅薩是1941年6月22日德意志軸心國對蘇聯發動的全面進攻，戰線由北極的基爾克內斯一直拉到黑海敖德薩附近，長約二千九百公里。德方骨幹是德國國防軍：最高統帥部直轄北方集團軍群（李布）、中央集團軍群（博克）、南方集團軍群（賴歇瑙）與烏克蘭集團軍群（庫希勒），總兵力約三百五十萬至三百八十萬人；另有武裝黨衛隊裝甲師「帝國」師、芬蘭軍兩個軍、羅馬尼亞第三與第四集團軍、義大利「哥薩克」支隊、匈牙利與斯洛伐克部隊，以及西班牙「藍色師」志願兵。海軍在波羅的海與黑海只作有限支援，空軍提供制空與近距支援，裝甲與摩托化部隊是突擊主力。蘇聯方面，紅軍在西線五個軍區（列寧格勒、波羅的海特別、西特別、西南、敖德薩）展開，內務人民委員部邊防部隊守護國界，西部兵員在四百萬人以上，戰車與裝甲車逾一萬輛，飛機近萬架但多屬老舊機型，另有臨時組織的民兵與游擊隊。軸心國沒有英美地面部隊參戰，但英蘇於1941年7月12日在莫斯科簽訂互助協議，首批租借物資船隊於8月20日抵達阿爾漢格爾斯克，戰爭的國際格局就此改變。
countriesEn: Operation Barbarossa was the full-scale German attack on the Soviet Union opened on 22 June 1941, with a front running from the Arctic approaches of Kirkenes down to the Black Sea near Odessa, a line about 2,900 kilometres long. The core of the Axis force was the German Wehrmacht: the OKW directed Army Groups North (Leeb), Centre (Bock), South (Reichenau) and Ukraine (Küchler), with total strength of roughly 3.5 to 3.8 million men. Alongside them fought the Waffen-SS armoured division Das Reich, two Finnish armies, the Romanian Third and Fourth Armies, the Italian so-called Cossack group, Hungarian and Slovak formations, and the volunteers of the Spanish Blue Division. The navy provided only limited support in the Baltic and the Black Sea, the air force delivered air superiority and close support, and the armoured and motorised troops formed the assault spearhead. On the Soviet side the Red Army was deployed in the five western military districts — Leningrad, Baltic Special, Western Special, Southwestern and Odessa — while NKVD border troops held the frontier; more than four million men, over ten thousand tanks and armoured cars, and nearly ten thousand aircraft, most of them obsolete types, faced the invader, supplemented by improvised militia units and partisans. No British or American ground troops fought on the Eastern Front, but the Anglo-Soviet Agreement was signed in Moscow on 12 July 1941 and the first Lend-Lease convoy reached Arkhangelsk on 20 August, redrawing the diplomatic and economic background of the war.
people: 巴巴羅薩由希特勒以最高統帥部的名義直接指揮，前線由四個集團軍群分段負責。北方集團軍群李布指揮第9、第16、第18集團軍向列寧格勒壓進；中央集團軍群博克指揮第4、第9、第2、第3裝甲集團軍與第6、第7集團軍，包辦明斯克與斯摩稜斯克方向；南方集團軍群賴歇瑙與後來的倫德斯泰特指揮第6、第17集團軍及第1、第4裝甲集團軍負責基輔方向；烏克蘭集團軍群庫希勒負責羅馬尼亞方向。古德里安以裝甲集群拉開戰線，1941年10月起升任裝甲兵總監，繼續主持東線的裝甲機動作戰；霍特於10月接任中央集團軍群司令，莫德爾在南方指揮第17集團軍，曼施泰因則於11月接手克里米亞的第11集團軍。空軍方面，卡塞林策劃對波爾塔瓦等蘇聯前線機場的突襲，摧毀了剛剛成形的蘇聯空軍編隊。蘇聯一端，鐵木辛哥任西南方面軍司令、主持基輔方向；朱可夫8月30日接掌預備軍，9月5日發動葉利尼亞反攻，9月起先後指揮第1突擊軍與西南方面軍；科涅夫在加里寧方向擋住通往莫斯科的道路；布瓊尼管理預備方面軍；裝甲兵總部主管庫利克無法扭轉機械化軍團戰車分散的弊病。羅科索夫斯基的第16集團軍、沃多羅金的第1近衛步兵軍、多瓦托爾的第316步兵師在冬季戰線上穩住陣腳。布列斯特要塞守軍在指揮官率領下抵抗到六月底，幾乎全數被俘或陣亡。
peopleEn: Barbarossa was directed personally by Hitler through the Führerhauptquartier, with the front divided among four army groups. Army Group North under Leeb sent the Ninth, Sixteenth and Eighteenth Armies against Leningrad; Army Group Centre under Bock commanded the Fourth, Ninth, Second and Third Panzer Groups and the Sixth and Seventh Armies, taking responsibility for the Minsk and Smolensk axes; Army Group South under Reichenau and later Rundstedt held the Sixth, Seventeenth, First and Fourth Panzer Groups for the Kiev direction; and Army Group Ukraine under Küchler covered the Romanian front. Guderian opened the campaign with the Panzer groupings, was promoted to Inspector General of the Panzer Troops in October 1941 and continued to direct the armoured war on the east; Hoth took over Army Group Centre in October, Model commanded the Seventeenth Army in the south, and Manstein assumed the Eleventh Army in the Crimea in November. In the air, Kesselring planned the raid on the Soviet forward airfields at Poltava and elsewhere, wrecking the newly formed Soviet air formations. On the Soviet side Timoshenko commanded the Southwestern Front and the Kiev sector; Zhukov took the Reserve Army on 30 August, launched the Yelnya counter-offensive on 5 September and from September led first the 1st Shock Army and then the Southwestern Front; Konev held the Kalinin direction covering the road to Moscow; Budyonny ran the Reserve Front; and Kulik, head of the armoured forces headquarters, could not repair the dispersal of the mechanised corps. Rokossovsky's 16th Army, Vatutin's 1st Guards Rifle Corps and Dovator's 316th Rifle Division steadied the line in the winter. The garrison of the Brest Fortress held out under its commandant until the end of June, and almost all of it was killed or taken prisoner.
kits: 卡面這件BT-7是蘇軍戰前的快速輕型坦克，1935年定型，採大行程克里斯蒂懸吊與500馬力引擎，最高時速三十二至三十五公里，全重約十四噸，裝甲十三至二十毫米，乘員三人，裝45毫米20-K與F-2／F-4戰車炮，並是蘇軍為數不多配備無線電的坦克。它在1939年前的蘇軍機械化軍團中擔任骨幹，至1941年6月蘇軍服役的BT-7約五千至六千五百輛，是全軍數量最多的戰車，編入西部各坦克旅與裝甲兵師。巴巴羅薩頭幾個星期裏，BT-7幾乎全部壓在前線。立陶宛拉塞尼亞一戰，蘇軍第5坦克旅以BT-7迎擊德軍裝甲師，一次戰鬥損失二十餘輛，幾乎全線瓦解；布羅迪一役的第8與第29機械化軍團同樣因戰車分散而被各個擊破。薄裝甲擋不住德軍37毫米戰車炮、50毫米長身管炮與75毫米師屬炮的射擊，1941年內損失的BT-7以千計，倖存者多改作牽引車，拖曳45毫米反戰車炮與76毫米野戰炮。德軍方面，III號與IV號坦克、裝37或75毫米炮的突擊砲（StuG III）、由88毫米高射炮改裝的反戰車炮、突擊砲兵與摩托化步兵的協同，構成突破正面；空軍以Ju 87俯衝轟炸機與Bf 109、Bf 110制空，掩護地面推進。補給方面，德軍在斯摩稜斯克與奧爾沙把蘇聯寬軌鐵路連同繳獲的機車車廂改接自己的標準軌，解決了遠距後勤的關鍵問題。
kitsEn: The BT-7 on the card face was the Soviet fast light tank of the pre-war army, standardised in 1935, built on long-travel Christie suspension with a 500-horsepower engine, capable of 32 to 35 kilometres per hour on road, weighing about fourteen tonnes, carrying 13 to 20 millimetres of armour with a crew of three, armed with the 45-millimetre 20-K and F-2/F-4 guns, and one of the few Soviet tanks fitted with a radio. It had been the backbone of the Soviet mechanised corps before 1939, and by June 1941 the Red Army had roughly five to six and a half thousand BT-7s in service, the most numerous tank in the army, distributed among the tank brigades and armoured divisions of the western districts. In the first weeks of Barbarossa practically every BT-7 was committed to the front. At Raseiniai in Lithuania the Soviet 5th Tank Brigade met a German armoured division with BT-7s and lost more than twenty vehicles in a single action, its line collapsing almost completely; at Brody the 8th and 29th Mechanised Corps were likewise defeated piecemeal because their tanks were spread too thin. The thin armour could not stop the 37-millimetre tank gun, the long 50-millimetre gun or the 75-millimetre divisional gun, and the BT-7s lost in 1941 numbered in the thousands; many survivors were converted to towing vehicles for 45-millimetre anti-tank guns and 76-millimetre field guns. On the German side the III and IV Panzer, the assault guns (StuG III) in 37- and 75-millimetre versions, 88-millimetre flak pieces used as anti-tank guns, assault pioneers and motorised infantry together formed the breakthrough front, while the Luftwaffe's Ju 87 dive bombers and Bf 109 and Bf 110 fighters won control of the air in front of the advancing infantry. For logistics, at Smolensk and Orsha the Germans converted the captured Soviet broad-gauge railway, re-gauged locomotives and wagons to their own standard gauge, solving the crucial problem of long-range supply.
tactics: 德軍在巴巴羅薩中把「楔形與熔爐」的戰法推到極致：先用步兵與炮兵在寬闊正面反覆滾動遮蔽射擊，牽制守軍主力，再以裝甲集群在數公里寬的突破口上形成楔形矛頭直插縱深，待突破兩翼守軍被切斷後合圍殲滅。突破重點由各集團軍群依命令指定，裝甲師不平均使用而是成建制投入；空地協同是關鍵，Stuka在攻勢前段反覆掃射縱深，制空權在初期壓倒性有利，突擊砲兵則用於清除反坦克壕與路障。蘇軍以多層防禦地帶迎戰：邊境線、莫托洛夫線與第聶伯羅多道阻擊區被編成數十個築壘地域，縱深挖反坦克壕、埋地雷並備有「瓶式」反坦克炸藥；預備隊不提前展開，嚴格偽裝保存，命令式反擊。1941年秋蘇軍新組二十九個步兵師，9月起第1突擊軍自瓦爾達丘陵長途行軍攻擊葉利尼亞，德軍戰線因而被頂住。冬季蘇軍轉入縱深攻擊，以坦克機械化集群配合游擊隊在敵後破壞鐵路公路，遊擊隊常以BT-7底盤改裝的車輛在林區與雪原襲擊德軍車隊。冬季作戰中步兵反坦克突擊組以手投反坦克手榴彈貼近攻擊，是少數能立即生效的辦法。
tacticsEn: In Barbarossa the Germans pushed the wedge-and-cauldron method to its extreme: infantry and artillery first put down rolling barrage after rolling barrage over a wide front to pin and blind the defenders, then armoured groups formed a wedge on a breakthrough front only a few kilometres wide and drove straight into the depth, closing the trap once the defenders on both flanks were cut off. The point of effort was fixed by order from each army group, and panzer divisions were used in full formations rather than spread thin; air-ground cooperation was decisive, since Stukas swept the depth in front of the advance and air superiority was overwhelmingly German in the opening phase, with assault pioneers clearing anti-tank ditches and obstacles. The Soviets answered with layered defensive belts: the frontier line, the Molotov Line and the Dnieper fortified region were organised into dozens of fortified areas, with anti-tank ditches, mines and improvised bottle charges in the depth; reserves were not deployed early, were kept under strict camouflage, and counter-attacked only on order. In the autumn of 1941 the Red Army raised twenty-nine new rifle divisions, and from September the 1st Shock Army marched from the Valdai hills to strike at Yelnya, which held the German line in place. In winter the Soviets turned to depth operations, combining armoured and mechanised groups with partisans who cut railways and roads behind the front, often using vehicles rebuilt on BT-7 chassis to raid German columns in forest and snow. In the winter fighting, infantry anti-tank assault groups working with hand-thrown anti-tank grenades at close range were one of the few measures that worked immediately.
data: 巴巴羅薩的規模在西線大戰中屬最大級別：戰線約二千九百公里，德方投入三百五十萬至三百八十萬人、戰車與裝甲車約三千三百五十輛、馬匹近六十萬匹、作戰飛機約三千架；蘇軍在西線集結四百萬人以上，戰車逾一萬輛、飛機近萬架，其中大量為老舊機型，內務人民委員部邊防部隊約十萬人，配屬火炮約一千四百門、坦克約九百輛。包圍殲滅的規模是這一役最醒目的數字：布列斯特包圍圈內有數十萬蘇軍被俘，明斯克方向被俘逾三十萬，斯摩稜斯克方向約三十萬，基輔包圍圈一次俘虜約六十六萬，維亞濟馬方向的包圍圈再吃掉約二十五萬。蘇軍1941年陣亡與被俘合計約三百萬人，損失或損失使用戰車約三千輛、作戰飛機逾三千架。德軍1941年傷亡合計約八十三萬至一百萬人，陣亡約二十五萬至三十萬，損失戰車約二千至三千輛。產能方面，蘇軍1941年生產坦克約六千六百輛、飛機約一萬五千七百架；同年約一千三百家企業內遷至烏拉爾與西伯利亞，8月20日首批英美援蘇船隊抵達阿爾漢格爾斯克，運載約三萬五千噸物資。
dataEn: Barbarossa was among the largest operations ever fought on the western front: about 2,900 kilometres of front, with 3.5 to 3.8 million German troops, roughly 3,350 tanks and armoured vehicles, close to 600,000 horses and about 3,000 combat aircraft committed, against more than four million Soviet troops, over ten thousand tanks and nearly ten thousand aircraft in the west, most of them obsolete types; the NKVD border troops numbered about 100,000 men with some 1,400 guns and 900 tanks. The scale of the encirclements is the most striking set of figures of the campaign: several hundred thousand Soviet troops were taken in the Brest pocket, over 300,000 in the Minsk direction, about 300,000 around Smolensk, some 660,000 in the single great sweep of the Kiev pocket, and another 250,000 in the Vyazma encirclement. Soviet dead and captured in 1941 together amounted to about three million, with around 3,000 tanks and more than 3,000 combat aircraft lost or destroyed. German casualties in 1941 totalled roughly 830,000 to one million, including 250,000 to 300,000 killed and 2,000 to 3,000 tanks lost. On the production side the Soviet Union built about 6,590 tanks and 15,700 aircraft in 1941, and some 1,300 enterprises were evacuated to the Urals and Siberia in the same year; on 20 August the first Anglo-American Lend-Lease convoy reached Arkhangelsk with roughly 35,000 tonnes of cargo.
cause: 巴巴羅薩不是一場偶然爆發的戰爭，而是希特勒長期決策的結果。1940年7月，德國國防軍最高統帥部完成對蘇作戰的初步方案，12月6日以第21號指令確認攻擊蘇聯的時間表。決策的出發點有三：英國始終沒有屈服，歐洲大陸的戰事停滯，軸心國亟需在英國取得空優之前先解決東線；蘇聯的五年計劃與1941至1942年的軍隊擴編被視為對德國的長期威脅；納粹的「生存空間」理論則認定東歐的糧食、鐵礦與石油必須奪取。1939年德蘇條約及其秘密議定書早已把波蘭、芬蘭、波羅的海與比薩爾比亞劃入勢力範圍，1940年蘇聯吞併這些地區之後，邊界上的衝突便不可迴避。希特勒相信蘇軍會重蹈波蘭戰役的覆轍：絕大多數部隊還在營區，訓練不足，指揮層混亂，國防軍的情報估計甚至認為蘇聯要到1942年才有能力組織有效抵抗。蘇聯領導層則低估了進攻的規模與時點，直到6月22日凌晨德軍三個方向同時開火，蘇聯仍試圖以政治手段爭取時間，6月29日才發布總動員令，七月初才把新組的二十九個步兵師一批批送往西線。
causeEn: Barbarossa was not a war that broke out by accident but the outcome of a long chain of decisions by Hitler. In July 1940 the German OKH completed a first plan for a war against the Soviet Union, and on 6 December Directive 21 fixed the timetable for the attack. Three motives stood behind it: Britain had not been beaten and the war in western Europe had stalled, so the Axis needed to settle the eastern front before winning air superiority over Britain; the Soviet Five-Year Plans and the Red Army expansion planned for 1941 and 1942 were seen as a long-term danger to Germany; and the Nazi doctrine of Lebensraum held that the grain, iron ore and oil of eastern Europe had to be seized. The Nazi-Soviet Pact of 1939 and its secret protocol had already divided Poland, Finland, the Baltic states and Bessarabia into spheres, and after the Soviet annexations of 1940 the clash on that border could not be avoided. Hitler believed the Red Army would repeat the collapse of the Polish campaigns: most of its units still in the barracks, inadequately trained, its command confused, and OKH intelligence even estimated that the Soviet Union would not be able to mount serious resistance before 1942. The Soviet leadership in turn underestimated the scale and timing of the blow, and only after German fire opened on three fronts in the small hours of 22 June did Moscow try to buy time by political means; the general mobilisation order followed on 29 June, and the twenty-nine newly raised rifle divisions were sent west in batches only from the beginning of July.
impact: 巴巴羅薩摧毀了紅軍戰前的編制與裝備體系，也在半年之內改寫了蘇聯國家的形態。西部大片土地落入德軍控制，1941年內有約一千三百家企業連同數百萬勞工被疏散到烏拉爾、西伯利亞與伏爾加河中游，國防工業在1942年即恢復並超過戰前產量；九月「為祖國、為史達林」的號召一次募集數百萬人，補充速度超過德軍的消耗速度。佔領區同時建立了殘酷的佔領體制，黨衛隊與警察部隊在後方執行大規模槍決，戰俘營的死亡率極高；1941年8月中央委員會的指令正式批准游擊戰爭，佔領軍的後方從此長期失衡。戰略上，巴巴羅薩粉碎了德國速戰速決的迷思：中央集團軍群在莫斯科城下第一次正面挫敗，希特勒的戰爭機器被迫轉入長期消耗，而德國工業無法承受持久戰的負荷。國際層面上，1941年7月12日英蘇莫斯科協議與8月14日大西洋憲章把蘇德戰爭納入同盟體系，首批租借物資在8月抵達北方港口。蘇聯由此獲得大量物質支援，也承擔了歐洲東線的全部壓力；對德國而言，巴巴羅薩之後是蘇聯戰場與地中海戰場並行的雙重負擔，以及1941年12月11日對美宣戰後的全線戰略。
impactEn: Barbarossa destroyed the pre-war structure and equipment of the Red Army, and within half a year reshaped the Soviet state itself. Vast tracts of the west passed under German control; during 1941 some 1,300 enterprises together with millions of workers were evacuated to the Urals, Siberia and the middle Volga, and by 1942 the defence industry was producing above its pre-war level. The call of September 1941, for the motherland and for Stalin, raised several million men in a single surge, and replacements outpaced German losses. In the occupied territories a brutal occupation system was erected, with SS and police units carrying out mass shootings in the rear and death rates in the prison camps reaching extreme levels; the Central Committee decree of August 1941 formally endorsed partisan war, and from then on the rear of the occupation armies was permanently unbalanced. Strategically Barbarossa shattered the German myth of the short war: Army Group Centre was checked in front of Moscow for the first time, the German war machine was forced into a war of attrition, and German industry could not carry the load of a long war. On the international stage the Anglo-Soviet Agreement of 12 July 1941 and the Atlantic Charter of 14 August drew the Soviet-German war into the coalition system, and the first Lend-Lease cargoes reached the northern ports in August. The Soviet Union thus gained substantial material support while carrying the whole weight of the eastern front; Germany inherited a double burden of the Soviet and Mediterranean theatres, and after declaring war on the United States on 11 December 1941, a global naval and strategic reckoning.
result: 巴巴羅薩在戰術上大勝，在戰略上失敗。德軍在半年攻勢中推進約一千公里，先後在布列斯特、明斯克、斯摩稜斯克、基輔與維亞濟馬完成五次大規模包圍殲滅，消滅了紅軍西部大部分骨幹，擄獲數十萬蘇軍與大量裝備；然而巴巴羅薩的戰略目標是消滅蘇聯紅軍主力並奪取其裝備與物資，而蘇軍在聶伯河以東仍保有上百個師的預備隊與龐大兵源，德軍恰恰停在了最需要殲滅的防線之前。九月起中央集團軍群戰線拉得過長，缺油、缺彈、缺馬料，補給線從鐵路末端延伸上千公里；十月「颱風」攻勢雖推進至莫斯科城下三十至四十公里，卻在十月至十二月的嚴寒中後續乏力。結果是蘇軍在莫斯科城下發動戰略反攻，連續實施加里寧、葉利尼亞與西南方向的反擊，奪回維爾紐斯與葉利尼亞等地，殲滅德軍第2裝甲軍與第4航空兵團的大量兵力，德軍退守列寧格勒至亞速海一線，比爾斯堡與羅斯托夫先後失守，制空權也在1942年逐步易手。巴巴羅薩沒有消滅蘇聯，反而把蘇聯推入全民備戰，把德國拖入一場無法速勝的消耗戰；冬季的失敗、冬季之後的泥濘，以及搬不走的工廠與自然資源，隨後在1942年的斯大林格勒與高加索戰線上以另一種形式再次決定戰爭走向。
resultEn: Barbarossa was a great tactical victory and a strategic failure. In six months of offensive the Germans advanced roughly a thousand kilometres, completing five large encirclements at Brest, Minsk, Smolensk, Kiev and Vyazma, destroying much of the backbone of the Red Army in the west and taking hundreds of thousands of Soviet prisoners together with enormous quantities of equipment. Yet the strategic aim of Barbarossa was to destroy the bulk of the Soviet army and seize its materiel, and east of the Dnieper the Soviets still held more than a hundred divisions in reserve together with a vast reservoir of manpower; the Germans stopped precisely in front of the line they most needed to annihilate. From September the front of Army Group Centre became over-extended, short of fuel, ammunition and fodder, with supply columns running a thousand kilometres beyond the railheads; the October offensive, Operation Typhoon, pushed to within thirty or forty kilometres of Moscow but ran out of strength in the freezing weather of October to December. The answer was a Soviet strategic counter-offensive in front of Moscow, with the Kalinin, Yelnya and south-western counter-strikes, the recapture of Vilnius and Yelnya, and the destruction of much of the Second Panzer Army and the Fourth Air Fleet; the Germans fell back to a line from Leningrad to the Sea of Azov, losing Briansk and Rostov in turn, and air superiority too passed to the Soviets during 1942. Barbarossa did not destroy the Soviet Union; it pushed the Soviet state into total war and dragged Germany into a war of attrition it could not win quickly. The defeat in the winter, the mud that followed it, and the factories and raw materials that could not be moved away would decide the war once more, in a different form, on the Stalingrad and Caucasus fronts of 1942.
